descriptor.source: Plates r3 (2026-10-16_elevation_r1/Plates/plates3_kit.py, s8 cap 26.5; the kit the 2026-10-17 restaurant wall34 render used): ONE blank cast in elevation x tilt states + the FD fold, re-laid with its own wall_spec (seed SEED+3, fold chain at col 5) for 45 x 14 modules (9.0 x 2.8 m, the in-situ gallery wall, fold chain as the render), gallery plan; every wall size up to 64 x 21 modules is laid again with the same generator (resize.flow: wall_spec at that size, the fold chain at 5/45 of the width and one step per row, so it runs top to bottom), a taller wall crops the gallery plan top-left or continues it by its own size (resize: tile). 10 distinct faces (F0 F1 F2 flats, A0 A1 A2 axis 3 deg, D0 D1 corner 3 deg, X0 axis 6 deg accent, FD fold = 11 with none dropped); joints are DECLARED hairline steps (max about 22 mm): the heightmap shows them as the kit has them.
